simple.meaning: בְּרִיאָה (bᵉrîyʼâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a creation , i.e. a novelty.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Numbers, beginning at Numbers 16:30. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּרִיאָה (H1278) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בְּרִיאָה (bᵉrîyʼâh) / H1278 is traced through Numbers 16:30 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H1278. beriah בְּרִיאָה noun feminine a creation, thing created , as preternatural, unparalleled; accusative of congnate meaning with verb י ׳יִבְרָא ׳אִםבֿ Num 16:30 , compare בָּרָא Qal 3, Niph`al 3.

occurrences.englishText: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol,* Sheol is the place of the dead. then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”
